ValidationRule.description: Requires source evidence, positive whole boxes, and the usage rate.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR( ISBLANK(Quantity__c), Quantity__c <= 0, MOD(Quantity__c, 1) <> 0, LEN(TRIM(Source_Reference__c)) = 0, AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Receipt", OR( NOT(REGEX(Source_Shipment_Item_Id__c, "[a-zA-Z0-9]{18}")), Event_Key__c <> ("REC/" & Source_Shipment_Item_Id__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Unit_Rate__c)) ) ), AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Consumption", OR(ISBLANK(Unit_Rate__c), Unit_Rate__c < 0, NOT(ISBLANK(Source_Shipment_Item_Id__c))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter the source reference and positive whole boxes. Receipt requires the matching shipment ID and key. Consumption requires a nonnegative unit rate.
